firm_data.firm_description: Rutherford & Christie has decades-long relationships with numerous national companies and serves as sole litigation counsel for some of America’s most recognized brands. Their collaborative approach leads to shorter discovery periods, earlier mediations, and more frequently obtained summary judgments and Daubert challenges.
